phase: Research only; no production code/API/UI changes
source: Same frozen real UTC+8 Binance snapshot as prior study; through 2026-10-20 closed day
selector: For each target day and Ganzhi, expanding own-valid closed history from 2017. Include if 100*up>=55*n or 100*down>=55*n. Flat in denominator; exact Decimal source comparison. No fitted threshold, minimum n or lookback search.
primary: Rolling selector using historical closes strictly before target UTC+8 day start; models trained on all eligible history as before; identical pre-existing OOS predictions scored on the selected dates.
retraining: No model retuning on selected test outcomes. Selection gates evaluation and alerts, not the historical training sample. Narrowing training as well would be a different untested hypothesis.
frozen_sensitivity: Choose Ganzhi and preferred direction once at 2023-01-01 using only pre2023 closes; evaluate 2023+ fixed pool
targets: All 11 original targets reported for each selector. Primary aligned interpretations: oc selector -> abs_oc,oc2/3/5,range5/10; cc selector -> abs_cc,cc2/3/5,range5/10. Cross-outcome rows diagnostic only.
models: All 17 original models and fixed parameters; original raw/cap99/omit2020/21/22 OOS prediction caches verified by hashes
primary_family: 2 selectors x (3 continuous MSE+MAE +8 events Brier+LogLoss) x4pairs =176; Holm jointly including cross-outcome endpoints
bootstrap: Circular blocks on original full calendar, including unselected dates with zero numerator/denominator contribution. Never compress gaps. Ratio estimate resamples selection indicator with paired losses. Pointwise95% intervals; centered two-sided block-bootstrap p; Holm176.
subgroups: Long vs short, yearly, causal close vs prior200-close moving average x prior30-day drift +/-20%; subgroup claims exploratory with separate Holm family.
robustness: Use already-run predictors trained with cap99 continuous targets or omitting each training year2020/21/22, score same raw outcomes and primary rolling selector; add selected long/short and frozen-pool sensitivities
permutation: Exploratory within-year rotations of state-adjusted raw residuals, selected-date group contrasts; 4999 rotations. Fixed selected path not re-estimated in null, so not an exact significance test for the adaptive selection algorithm.
direction_validation: Selected preferred-direction hit rate, long/short separately; historical selection rate is not a future success guarantee. Compare majority-BTC causal direction baseline on same selected dates; no trading PnL.
alerts: Same selected-date top10/20% forecast quota diagnostic, plus actual online threshold from past365 calendar days of previously selected predictions (>=60 required).
group_tests: Year-cluster t intervals on selected OOS paired loss improvements; Holm across all available selector x60group x11target x2pair tests; few years limit coverage.
macro: Main F/G omit unprovably pre-known historical CPI/NFP dates; F_retro/G_retro only retrospective conditional sensitivity.
adaptive_research_caveat: 55% restriction requested after all-Ganzhi study outcomes were seen. This is additional exploratory research on same historical period, not a pristine new confirmation holdout. Future untouched data needed for a positive result.
